name: SuperWoW 2.2
body: ### 16/07/2026: 2.2 - More Improvements to NameplateMotion Smart Spread mode, added Compact Spread mode. - Refactored Quest ID & link functions to three distinct functions with more descriptive & less generic names, should solve most addon compatibility: GetQuestIDForLogIndex(questIndex); GetQuestLinkForLogIndex(questIndex); GetQuestLinkForID(questID) [Remember to update SuperAPI as well!](https://github.com/balakethelock/SuperAPI) For more info: https://github.com/balakethelock/SuperWoW/wiki/Changelog https://github.com/balakethelock/SuperWoW/wiki/Features Coming Soon: HD Text rendering! Support the project for exclusive access to behind the scenes news, sneak-peeks, and beta testing. [](https://ko-fi.com/balakesuperwow)
